## What's New — v0.1.12 (October 2026)

> **`matrixprofiler` is the high-performance C++ engine** of the Matrix Profile ecosystem.
> This release focuses on native parallelism, new algorithms, and safer NA handling.

Key highlights:

- ⚡ **`RcppThread`** replaces `RcppParallel`/Intel TBB — zero-dependency, fork-safe multithreading on all platforms.
- 🆕 **`contrast()`** — native Contrast Profile computation with multi-threading, Pearson and Euclidean distance metrics.
- 🆕 **`rfcp()` & `rfcp_top_k()`** — Relative Frequency Contrast Profile with Top-K morphology discovery, frequency adaptation, checkpoints, and CUDA acceleration.
- 🆕 **`mstomp()`** — native C++ Multivariate STOMP with `n_workers` support.
- 🆕 **`mpdist()`** — native C++ MPdist (scalar and vector variants), multi-thread.
- 🔢 **`NA_integer_`** — invalid profile indices now follow R's canonical missing-value convention (was `-1L`).
- 🛡️ **`na_strategy`** for all `mov_*` window functions — predictable, non-cascading NA handling.

📄 Full API changes, breaking changes, and migration guide: **[MIGRATION.md](https://github.com/matrix-profile-foundation/matrixprofiler/blob/main/MIGRATION.md)**

### Overview

R package implementing the UCR Matrix Profile Algorithm (<http://www.cs.ucr.edu/~eamonn/MatrixProfile.html>)
as an optimised C++17 engine.

This package provides the **core computational primitives** for building and querying Matrix Profiles.
Higher-level analytics (motif search, segmentation, snippets, plotting) live in the
[`tsmp`](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=tsmp) package, which uses `matrixprofiler` as its backend.

### Installation

```{r installation, gh-installation, eval = FALSE}
# Install the released version from CRAN
install.packages("matrixprofiler")
# Or the development version from GitHub:
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("matrix-profile-foundation/matrixprofiler")
```

#### Optional: NVIDIA CUDA GPU Acceleration

By default, `matrixprofiler` installs as a portable, high-performance CPU engine with multi-threading via `RcppThread` (zero external dependencies, 100% CRAN compliant).

If you have an **NVIDIA GPU** and the **CUDA Toolkit** installed, you can compile `matrixprofiler` with native CUDA acceleration for supported algorithms (such as `rfcp()` and `mpx()`):

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/matrix-profile-foundation/matrixprofiler.git
cd matrixprofiler

# Compile CUDA kernels and install directly into your R library
./inst/cuda/build_cuda_rcpp.sh R CMD INSTALL .
# or with devtools:
./inst/cuda/build_cuda_rcpp.sh Rscript -e 'devtools::install()'
```

Once installed, check if CUDA is enabled in your R session:

```{r cuda-check, eval = FALSE}
library(matrixprofiler)
has_cuda()
#> [1] TRUE
```

### Currently available Features

* **STAMP** (single and multi-thread)
* **STOMP** (single and multi-thread)
* **SCRIMP** (single and multi-thread, not for AB-joins yet)
* **MPX** (single and multi-thread)
* **Contrast Profile (`contrast`)** — Contrast profile between positive and negative classes (Euclidean/Pearson, multi-thread)
* **RFCP (`rfcp`)** — Relative Frequency Contrast Profile for discriminative pattern discovery (CPU multi-threaded & CUDA GPU)
* **Top-K Morphology Discovery (`rfcp_top_k`)** — Iterative discovery of top-K distinct morphologies with frequency adaptation and checkpointing
* **mSTOMP** — Multivariate STOMP, native C++ with `n_workers`
* **MPdist** — Matrix Profile Distance, scalar and vector variants, multi-thread
* Misc:
  * MASS v2.0 / v3.0 (multi-variant)
  * MASS extensions: WQ (Weighted Query), ABS (Absolute), UN (Unnormalized)
  * Sliding-window functions (`mov_mean`, `mov_std`, `mov_var`, `mov_min`, `mov_max`, `muinvn`, `zero_crossing`)
    with `na_strategy = c("window_na", "remove", "error")` and `na.rm` control

### Roadmap

- [x] Replace Intel TBB / `RcppParallel` with `RcppThread` (fork-safe, zero external dep)
- [x] Native Multivariate STOMP (`mstomp()`) in C++
- [x] Native MPdist (`mpdist()`) in C++
- [x] Contrast Profile (`contrast()`) in native C++
- [x] Relative Frequency Contrast Profile (`rfcp()`) and Top-K Morphology Discovery (`rfcp_top_k()`)
- [x] Standardise invalid indices to `NA_integer_`
- [x] `na_strategy` for all sliding-window functions
- [ ] STOMPi (On-line / streaming version)
- [ ] SiMPle-Fast (Music Analysis)
- [ ] VALMOD (Variable Length Motifs) — candidate for `matrixprofiler` core
- [ ] MASS extensions: ADP (Approximate Distance Profile, with PAA), QwG (Query with Gap)
